subslides.clause_html: X_1 is the incenter of reference triangle ABC — the center of the unique inscribed circle tangent to all three sidelines.
subslides.just_title: To inscribe a circle in a given triangle (Elements Book IV, Proposition 4).

subslides.enunciation: The intersection of the three interior angle bisectors and center of the inscribed circle of triangle ABC.
subslides.clause_html: The three interior angle bisectors AI_a, BI_b, CI_c concur at X_1, while the incircle touches the sides at the intouch triangle T_a T_b T_c.
subslides.just_title: Cevian triangle: Incentral triangle I_a I_b I_c • Pedal triangle: Intouch triangle T_a T_b T_c.

subslides.enunciation: The intersection of the three interior angle bisectors and center of the inscribed circle of triangle ABC.
subslides.clause_html: Trilinear Coordinates in Pictures: α : β : γ measure the directed perpendicular distances from X_1 to sidelines BC, CA, AB.Every perpendicular strut is an incircle radius r, so α : β : γ = 1 : 1 : 1.
subslides.just_title: Exact actual trilinear distances: (α, β, γ) = (r, r, r) where r = Area(ABC) / s.

subslides.clause_html: Barycentric Coordinates in Pictures: u : v : w measure the signed areas of sub-triangles △X_1BC, △X_1CA, △X_1AB.Since Area = ½·base·r, the sub-areas scale directly with the side lengths: u : v : w = a : b : c.

subslides.just_title: On reference triangle (5, 6, 7), X_1 partitions Area(ABC) into 5 : 6 : 7 (27.8% : 33.3% : 38.9%).

subslides.enunciation: The intersection of the three interior angle bisectors and center of the inscribed circle of triangle ABC.
subslides.clause_html: The Coordinate Trio: X_1 equalizes perpendicular distances (1:1:1 trilinears); X_2 equalizes sub-triangle areas (1:1:1 barycentrics); X_6 scales distances by a:b:c and areas by a²:b²:c².
subslides.just_title: X_1 is self-isogonal; X_2 and X_6 are isogonal conjugates (1/a : 1/b : 1/c ↔ a : b : c).
